title: 【RPG Design Guides】Making Trash Mob Battles Less Tedious

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】雑魚戦を作業にしない
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Making Trash Mob Battles Less Tedious

blocks.source: ＲＰＧの雑魚戦をいかに面白くするかというのは悩ましい問題だ。
blocks.translation: Figuring out how to make trash mob battles in RPGs interesting is a difficult problem.

blocks.source: 一方で「つまらない雑魚戦とは何か？」という問題には、ある程度の答えを出せると思う。その一つは雑魚戦が作業と化していることだ。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, I think we can provide some answers to the question, “What makes a trash mob battle boring?” One such answer is when trash mob battles become tedious chores.

blocks.source: 一般的にＲＰＧの雑魚戦には以下のような特徴がある。
blocks.translation: In general, trash mob battles in RPGs have the following characteristics.

blocks.source: 同じ敵と何度も戦う。
blocks.translation: You fight the same enemies repeatedly.

blocks.source: 回数が多い。長編ならクリアまでに何百回と戦うことも。
blocks.translation: There are many battles. In a long game, you may fight hundreds of battles before clearing it.

blocks.source: ボスより弱く、プレイヤーが負けることは少ない。
blocks.translation: They are weaker than bosses, so the player rarely loses.

blocks.source: 上記の特徴により、雑魚戦は「同じ条件で同じ敵と戦う」場面が何度も発生しがちになる。必然的にその結果も見えており、運の要素が大きくない場合は、一度倒した相手に負けることは少ない。
blocks.translation: Because of these characteristics, trash mob battles tend to repeatedly involve fighting the same enemies under the same conditions. The outcome is therefore usually predictable, and when luck is not a major factor, it is uncommon to lose to an enemy you have already defeated once.

blocks.source: つまり、多くの雑魚戦は構造的に「開始した瞬間からプレイヤーの勝利が確定している作業」のようなものとなっている。勝利までの流れも多くの場合で一定となっており、そうなると新鮮味も薄くなってしまう。
blocks.translation: In other words, structurally, many trash mob battles are like chores in which the player's victory is guaranteed from the moment the battle begins. The path to victory is also often the same, which causes the battles to lose their freshness.

blocks.source: 当然、こういった戦闘を何度も繰り返すのはプレイヤーにとって退屈となる。
blocks.translation: Naturally, repeatedly fighting battles like these becomes boring for the player.

blocks.source: そこでどのようにすれば、この作業感を軽減できるのかを考えてみたい。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I would like to consider how to reduce this sense of tedium.

blocks.source: 目次
blocks.translation: Table of Contents

blocks.source: リソース管理を活かす
blocks.translation: Make Use of Resource Management

blocks.source: 最も古典的な方法はリソース管理を活かすことだ。
blocks.translation: The most classic method is to make use of resource management.

blocks.source: リソースとはＨＰやＭＰ、回復アイテムなど数に限りのある資源を指す。ここでは特に戦闘が終了しても引き継がれるリソースを指す。
blocks.translation: Resources are limited assets such as HP, MP, and recovery items. Here, I am referring particularly to resources that carry over even after a battle ends.

blocks.source: 【参考】戦闘システム③ リソースシステム
blocks.translation: 【Reference】Battle Systems ③: Resource Systems

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/316336123.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/316336123.html

blocks.source: 例えば、ドラクエシリーズではダンジョンを進む中でＨＰやＭＰなどの管理を行う必要がある。繰り返される戦闘の中でリソースは徐々に減少していくので、刻一刻と状況に変化が生まれる。
blocks.translation: For example, in the Dragon Quest series, you need to manage HP and MP as you make your way through a dungeon. Since resources gradually decrease over the course of repeated battles, the situation changes from moment to moment.

blocks.source: ダンジョンの入口付近では楽勝だった雑魚敵も、ＭＰが尽きた状況では対処が困難になるというわけだ。
blocks.translation: An enemy that was easy to defeat near the dungeon entrance can become difficult to deal with when your MP has run out.

blocks.source: そして、そうならないために、プレイヤーも雑魚戦でいかにＨＰやＭＰを温存するかという駆け引きが生まれる。
blocks.translation: To prevent that from happening, players must also weigh how to conserve HP and MP during trash mob battles.

blocks.source: もちろん、リソース管理はバランス調整が肝となる。
blocks.translation: Of course, balance adjustments are the key to resource management.

blocks.source: もし、ＭＰを消費しない攻撃手段だけで、敵を蹴散らせるならＭＰの価値は薄れる。あるいは、ＭＰ自体を簡単に回復できてしまうなら、やはりプレイヤーが悩む必要もなくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: If enemies can be swept away using only attacks that do not consume MP, MP loses much of its value. Likewise, if MP itself can be restored easily, the player no longer has any reason to worry about it.

blocks.source: 前述した通り、リソース管理は古典的な手法であり、旧来のＲＰＧではこれによって長いダンジョンに緊張感を持たせるよう設計されていた。
blocks.translation: As mentioned earlier, resource management is a classic technique, and older RPGs were designed to create tension in long dungeons through its use.

blocks.source: ところが、時代と共にリソース管理を大幅に緩和された作品が出るようになっていった。
blocks.translation: However, over time, games began to appear that greatly relaxed the demands of resource management.

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ２では戦闘終了後にＨＰが全快するようになった。
blocks.translation: In Romancing SaGa 2, HP became fully restored after each battle.

blocks.source: ドラクエ６ではＭＰを消費しない特技が猛威をふるい、ドラクエ１１（正確には３ＤＳ版ＤＱ８から）ではレベルアップでＨＰやＭＰが全快するようになった。
blocks.translation: In Dragon Quest VI, Techs that did not consume MP became overwhelmingly powerful, while in Dragon Quest XI (more precisely, starting with the 3DS version of Dragon Quest VIII), leveling up fully restored HP and MP.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３やゼノブレイドに至ってはＭＰに該当する要素も存在しないため、リソース管理の必要性もほぼなくなってしまった。
blocks.translation: In games such as Final Fantasy XIII and Xenoblade, there is not even an element corresponding to MP, so the need for resource management has nearly disappeared.

blocks.source: リソースの制限がゆるい場合、消耗を考えず思い切り戦えるという利点もある。
blocks.translation: Looser resource restrictions also have the advantage of allowing players to fight all-out without worrying about exhaustion.

blocks.source: 一方でリソースの制限には上記のような重要性もある。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, resource restrictions also have the important functions described above.

blocks.source: リソース管理を不要にした結果、全体としてかえって退屈なものになっていないかはよく考えたい。
blocks.translation: It is worth carefully considering whether eliminating the need for resource management has instead made the game more boring overall.

blocks.source: 敵構成に変化をつける
blocks.translation: Vary Enemy Compositions

blocks.source: 敵の種類や組み合わせが豊富ならば、同じ条件での戦闘が少なくなる。
blocks.translation: If there is a wide variety of enemy types and combinations, there will be fewer battles fought under the same conditions.

blocks.source: 長いダンジョンでも出現する敵が徐々に変わっていくなら、単調さもいくらか緩和できるだろう。
blocks.translation: Even in a long dungeon, gradually changing the enemies that appear can alleviate the monotony to some extent.

blocks.source: ただし、敵が変化しても強さがあまり代わり映えしないようなバランスだとこの効果は実感できない。しっかりと敵の個性をつけよう。
blocks.translation: However, this effect will not be noticeable if the balance makes the enemies feel much the same in terms of strength, even when they change. Be sure to give the enemies distinct personalities.

blocks.source: 時折、敵が行動する前に一方的に完封できてしまうシステム＆バランスの作品も見かけるけど、これも敵の個性が見えなくなってしまうという点では同じなので注意して欲しい。
blocks.translation: I sometimes see games with systems and balance that allow players to completely shut down enemies before they can even act. Be careful, because this has the same problem: the enemies' unique characteristics become impossible to see.

blocks.source: ランダム性を高める
blocks.translation: Increase Randomness

blocks.source: 敵の行動パターン、命中率やクリティカル、状態異常の命中率などのランダム要素を組み込むことで変化をつける。前述した敵構成にランダム性を組み込んでもいいだろう。
blocks.translation: Add variety by incorporating random elements such as enemy behavior patterns, hit rates, critical hits, and the hit rates of status ailments. You could also add randomness to the enemy compositions mentioned above.

blocks.source: これによって、戦闘が同じような展開になることを減らす。さらには、油断すると雑魚戦でも思わぬ苦戦を強いられるようにする。
blocks.translation: This reduces the likelihood that battles will unfold in the same way. It can also make players suffer unexpected difficulties even in trash mob battles if they let their guard down.

blocks.source: これはメガテンシリーズが分かりやすいだろう。
blocks.translation: The Shin Megami Tensei series is a good example of this.

blocks.source: 弱点を突いたり、クリティカルが発生すると連続行動できるプレスターンはシステム的にもこれを強調している。
blocks.translation: The Press Turn system also emphasizes this idea mechanically, allowing consecutive actions when you hit an enemy's weakness or land a critical hit.

blocks.source: ただし、あまりやりすぎると理不尽な運ゲーになるので注意。
blocks.translation: However, be careful not to overdo it, or the game may become an unfair game of chance.

blocks.source: 難易度を上げて緊張感を演出
blocks.translation: Raise the Difficulty to Create Tension

blocks.source: 「油断すると雑魚戦でも思わぬ苦戦を強いられる」という点は上と同じだが、それを難易度面でも強調する方法。
blocks.translation: This method emphasizes the same point as above—that letting your guard down can lead to unexpected difficulties even in trash mob battles—but does so through the difficulty level.

blocks.source: 上述したメガテンの他、サガシリーズなども分かりやすい。
blocks.translation: In addition to the Shin Megami Tensei games mentioned above, the SaGa series is another easy-to-understand example.

blocks.source: 必然的に一戦闘が重くなりやすいことには注意。
blocks.translation: Keep in mind that this naturally tends to make each battle more demanding.

blocks.source: 雑魚戦が長びくのは作業感をむしろ強めるので、場合によっては逆効果になりかねない。
blocks.translation: Making trash mob battles drag on can actually intensify the sense of tedium, so this approach may have the opposite effect in some cases.

blocks.source: ロマサガシリーズのように、雑魚戦は短期決戦かつ激しい戦闘を意識するといいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: As in the Romancing SaGa series, it may be a good idea to make trash mob battles short but intense.

blocks.source: 戦闘の比重を下げる
blocks.translation: Reduce the Emphasis on Combat

blocks.source: 戦闘を何度も長々と見せられるのが退屈なのだったら、なるべく見せないでしまえという発想。
blocks.translation: If having to watch long battles over and over is boring, the idea is to show as little of them as possible.

blocks.source: 格下との戦闘を短期決戦にしたり、自動戦闘でサクッと終わらせられるようにする。マザーシリーズなど格下の敵は戦闘なしで瞬殺できる作品もある。
blocks.translation: Make battles against weaker enemies short and decisive, or allow them to end quickly through auto-battle. In some games, such as the EarthBound series, weaker enemies can be instantly defeated without entering battle.

blocks.source: あるいは、ダンジョンの長さやエンカウント率を抑えて、ほどほどの戦闘回数で次へ進めるようにしてもよい。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, you could limit dungeon length and encounter rates so that players can move on after a moderate number of battles.

blocks.source: また、逃走率を高めに設定するのも、戦闘の比重を下げる方策である。
blocks.translation: Also, setting a high escape rate is another way to reduce the emphasis on combat.

blocks.source: ドラクエの聖水のように格下の敵とのエンカウント率を下げるアイテムやスキルを作るのもよいだろう。
blocks.translation: It might also be a good idea to create items or skills that reduce the encounter rate with weaker enemies, like Dragon Quest's Holy Water.

blocks.source: この種の機能はシンボルエンカウントだとあまり見かけないが、工夫次第でやりようはあるので試してみて欲しい。
blocks.translation: You do not often see this kind of feature with symbol encounters, but it can be implemented with some ingenuity, so I encourage you to give it a try.

blocks.source: あるいは、レベルが上がると自動的に敵が寄ってこなくなるようなシステムを作ってみてもよいと思う。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, you could try creating a system in which enemies automatically stop approaching you once your level gets high enough.

blocks.source: ただし、道中の雑魚戦の回数を抑えても、ボス戦が壁となって結局雑魚戦での稼ぎを何度もさせられるなら本末転倒なのは言うまでもない。
blocks.translation: However, even if you limit the number of regular battles along the way, it defeats the purpose if a boss battle becomes a roadblock and ultimately forces the player to grind through regular battles repeatedly.

blocks.source: 一見すると『難易度を上げて緊張感を演出』とは逆に、難易度が低めでストーリー重視の作品に向いていそうだが、実は高難易度の作品とも相性は悪くない。
blocks.translation: At first glance, this may seem more suited to games with relatively low difficulty and a strong focus on story—the opposite of “increase the difficulty to create tension”—but it is actually not a bad fit for high-difficulty games either.

blocks.source: 例えば、ロマサガ２では、
blocks.translation: For example, in Romancing SaGa 2,

blocks.source: 雑魚戦は短期決戦。
blocks.translation: Regular battles are short and decisive.

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントによって戦闘を回避しやすい。
blocks.translation: Symbol encounters make it easy to avoid battles.

blocks.source: （少なくとも同時代のＲＰＧよりは）
blocks.translation: (At least compared with RPGs from the same era)

blocks.source: 戦闘から１００％逃げられる。
blocks.translation: You can escape from battles 100% of the time.

blocks.source: （重大なデメリットはあるけど……）
blocks.translation: (Though there are significant drawbacks...)

blocks.source: ダンジョンもそこまで長くない。
blocks.translation: The dungeons are not particularly long, either.

blocks.source: というように、戦闘の比重を下げるための調整が多くなされている。
blocks.translation: In this way, many adjustments have been made to reduce the emphasis on combat.

blocks.source: このように「高難易度だからこそ、戦闘の回数や長さを抑える」という調整もアリだろう。
blocks.translation: Thus, it may be worthwhile to make adjustments such as “limiting the number and length of battles precisely because the game is highly difficult.”

blocks.source: 報酬を奮発する
blocks.translation: Offer Generous Rewards

blocks.source: 戦闘自体は作業であっても報酬がおいしいなら、それなりに頑張れるというもの。
blocks.translation: Even if the battles themselves feel like chores, you can put in a reasonable effort if the rewards are worthwhile.

blocks.source: ここでいう報酬とは経験値やお金などを意味しており、その大半がプレイヤーの強化につながるものとなる。
blocks.translation: The rewards mentioned here mean things such as experience points and money, most of which contribute to strengthening the player.

blocks.source: 報酬が多いということは、プレイヤー側の強化も早いということ。
blocks.translation: More rewards also mean faster progression for the player.

blocks.source: 当初は苦戦していた敵に楽勝できるようになるため、プレイヤーとしても気分が良い。変化を実感できるため「同じことを繰り返している」という感覚も薄れるだろう。
blocks.translation: Since enemies that were initially difficult become easy to defeat, the player feels good as well. Being able to feel the change also makes the experience of “repeating the same thing” less pronounced.

blocks.source: 逆に言うと、戦闘の報酬が乏しい作品では戦闘の作業感が増してしまう。
blocks.translation: Conversely, in games with meager combat rewards, battles feel even more like chores.

blocks.source: これはシステム面の問題によって引き起こされることもある。
blocks.translation: This can also be caused by problems with the game systems.

blocks.source: レベルキャップなどの成長限界にすぐ達してしまう。
blocks.translation: The player quickly reaches a growth limit, such as a level cap.

blocks.source: 敵が格下だと得られる経験値が大きく下がる。
blocks.translation: The experience points gained drop significantly when the enemy is much weaker.

blocks.source: こちらに比例して敵も強くなっていく。
blocks.translation: The enemies grow stronger in proportion to the player's strength.

blocks.source: 具体的には上記のようなシステムが例として挙げられる。
blocks.translation: The systems listed above are specific examples.

blocks.source: 意味のない戦闘をさせるぐらいなら、戦闘自体をカットできるようにしたほうがマシかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Rather than making the player fight meaningless battles, it might be better to make it possible to skip the battles altogether.

blocks.source: では、ただ報酬を多くすればいいかというと、これも意外と難しい。
blocks.translation: That said, simply increasing the rewards is surprisingly difficult as well.

blocks.source: というのも、前述した通り「報酬が多いということは、プレイヤー側の強化も早い」ということ。つまり、すぐに戦闘に苦戦しなくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: As mentioned earlier, “more rewards mean faster progression for the player.” In other words, the player quickly stops struggling in battle.

blocks.source: 戦闘に苦戦しない状態では、強くなりたいというプレイヤーの動機も弱くなる。自然、報酬の喜びも減ってしまう。
blocks.translation: When battles are no longer difficult, the player's motivation to become stronger also weakens. Naturally, the joy of receiving rewards diminishes as well.

blocks.source: つまり、報酬が多いほど報酬が機能しなくなるのが早いという矛盾があるのだ。
blocks.translation: In other words, the more generous the rewards are, the sooner they stop serving their purpose—a contradiction.

blocks.source: 対策としては、やはり報酬は程々に割り当てることだろう。
blocks.translation: As a countermeasure, it is probably best to keep the rewards at a moderate level.

blocks.source: あるいは、敵の強さを負けじとインフレさせる方法も考えられるが、こちらは弊害もそれなりに多い。レベル上げが全ての大味なゲームになりかねないので限度がある。
blocks.translation: Another possibility is to increase the enemies' strength just as aggressively, but this also has quite a few negative side effects. There is a limit, since the game could end up becoming a simplistic experience where leveling up is all that matters.

blocks.source: 他にも、戦闘内容によって報酬を増やすような仕組みがあれば、勝敗の確定した雑魚戦であっても操作を頑張る動機が生まれるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, if there were a system that increased rewards based on how the battle was fought, it might give players a reason to put effort into their actions even in regular battles whose outcome is already certain.

blocks.source: ただし、それ自体が新たな作業を生み出すこともあるので要注意。
blocks.translation: However, be careful, as this itself could create a new chore.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 近年プレイしたＲＰＧにおいて、格下との雑魚戦に強い作業感を覚えることが個人的に多かった。
blocks.translation: In the RPGs I have played in recent years, I have often personally found regular battles against weaker enemies to feel particularly grindy.

blocks.source: その原因と対策を考えたのが、この記事だと言える。
blocks.translation: This article could be said to be my attempt to consider the causes and solutions.

blocks.source: 特に近年はリソース管理のゆるい作品が増加傾向にあり、加えてマップも広大化しているため戦闘回数も多い。それらが大きな原因なのではないかと推察している。
blocks.translation: In particular, games with lenient resource management have been increasing in recent years, and maps have also been growing larger, resulting in more battles. I suspect these are major causes.

blocks.source: なお、この記事で挙げた項目の中には相反するものもあることに注意して欲しい。
blocks.translation: Note that some of the points raised in this article conflict with one another.

blocks.source: 例えば、『戦闘の比重を下げる』ために確実に戦闘から逃げられるようにした場合、『難易度を上げて緊張感を演出』『リソース管理を活かす』といった方向にはマイナスに作用してしまう。
blocks.translation: For example, if you make it possible to escape from battles reliably in order to “reduce the emphasis on combat,” it will work against goals such as “increasing the difficulty to create tension” and “making use of resource management.”

blocks.source: どれだけＨＰやＭＰが減っていても安全に進めてしまうのだから、必然的にそうなってしまう。
blocks.translation: Since the player can proceed safely no matter how much HP or MP has been depleted, this outcome is inevitable.

blocks.source: どの手段を取るのかは自由だが、ゲームデザインの方針には矛盾がないようにしておこう。
blocks.translation: You are free to choose which approach to take, but make sure your game design principles are not contradictory.

texts.ＲＰＧの雑魚戦をいかに面白くするかというのは悩ましい問題だ。: Figuring out how to make trash mob battles in RPGs interesting is a difficult problem.
texts.一方で「つまらない雑魚戦とは何か？」という問題には、ある程度の答えを出せると思う: On the other hand, I think we can provide some answers to the question, “What makes a trash mob battle boring?” One such answer is when trash mob battles become tedious chores.
texts.一般的にＲＰＧの雑魚戦には以下のような特徴がある。: In general, trash mob battles in RPGs have the following characteristics.
texts.同じ敵と何度も戦う。: You fight the same enemies repeatedly.
texts.回数が多い。長編ならクリアまでに何百回と戦うことも。: There are many battles. In a long game, you may fight hundreds of battles before clearing it.
texts.ボスより弱く、プレイヤーが負けることは少ない。: They are weaker than bosses, so the player rarely loses.
texts.上記の特徴により、雑魚戦は「同じ条件で同じ敵と戦う」場面が何度も発生しがちになる: Because of these characteristics, trash mob battles tend to repeatedly involve fighting the same enemies under the same conditions. The outcome is therefore usually predictable, and when luck is not a major factor, it is uncommon to lose to an enemy you have already defeated once.
texts.つまり、多くの雑魚戦は構造的に「開始した瞬間からプレイヤーの勝利が確定している作: In other words, structurally, many trash mob battles are like chores in which the player's victory is guaranteed from the moment the battle begins. The path to victory is also often the same, which causes the battles to lose their freshness.
texts.当然、こういった戦闘を何度も繰り返すのはプレイヤーにとって退屈となる。: Naturally, repeatedly fighting battles like these becomes boring for the player.
texts.そこでどのようにすれば、この作業感を軽減できるのかを考えてみたい。: With that in mind, I would like to consider how to reduce this sense of tedium.
texts.最も古典的な方法はリソース管理を活かすことだ。: The most classic method is to make use of resource management.
texts.リソースとはＨＰやＭＰ、回復アイテムなど数に限りのある資源を指す。ここでは特に戦: Resources are limited assets such as HP, MP, and recovery items. Here, I am referring particularly to resources that carry over even after a battle ends.
texts.例えば、ドラクエシリーズではダンジョンを進む中でＨＰやＭＰなどの管理を行う必要が: For example, in the Dragon Quest series, you need to manage HP and MP as you make your way through a dungeon. Since resources gradually decrease over the course of repeated battles, the situation changes from moment to moment.
texts.ダンジョンの入口付近では楽勝だった雑魚敵も、ＭＰが尽きた状況では対処が困難になる: An enemy that was easy to defeat near the dungeon entrance can become difficult to deal with when your MP has run out.
texts.そして、そうならないために、プレイヤーも雑魚戦でいかにＨＰやＭＰを温存するかとい: To prevent that from happening, players must also weigh how to conserve HP and MP during trash mob battles.
texts.もちろん、リソース管理はバランス調整が肝となる。: Of course, balance adjustments are the key to resource management.
texts.もし、ＭＰを消費しない攻撃手段だけで、敵を蹴散らせるならＭＰの価値は薄れる。ある: If enemies can be swept away using only attacks that do not consume MP, MP loses much of its value. Likewise, if MP itself can be restored easily, the player no longer has any reason to worry about it.
texts.前述した通り、リソース管理は古典的な手法であり、旧来のＲＰＧではこれによって長い: As mentioned earlier, resource management is a classic technique, and older RPGs were designed to create tension in long dungeons through its use.
texts.ところが、時代と共にリソース管理を大幅に緩和された作品が出るようになっていった。: However, over time, games began to appear that greatly relaxed the demands of resource management.
texts.ロマンシングサガ２では戦闘終了後にＨＰが全快するようになった。: In Romancing SaGa 2, HP became fully restored after each battle.

texts.ＦＦ１３やゼノブレイドに至ってはＭＰに該当する要素も存在しないため、リソース管理: In games such as Final Fantasy XIII and Xenoblade, there is not even an element corresponding to MP, so the need for resource management has nearly disappeared.
texts.リソースの制限がゆるい場合、消耗を考えず思い切り戦えるという利点もある。: Looser resource restrictions also have the advantage of allowing players to fight all-out without worrying about exhaustion.
texts.一方でリソースの制限には上記のような重要性もある。: On the other hand, resource restrictions also have the important functions described above.
texts.リソース管理を不要にした結果、全体としてかえって退屈なものになっていないかはよく: It is worth carefully considering whether eliminating the need for resource management has instead made the game more boring overall.
texts.敵の種類や組み合わせが豊富ならば、同じ条件での戦闘が少なくなる。: If there is a wide variety of enemy types and combinations, there will be fewer battles fought under the same conditions.
texts.長いダンジョンでも出現する敵が徐々に変わっていくなら、単調さもいくらか緩和できる: Even in a long dungeon, gradually changing the enemies that appear can alleviate the monotony to some extent.
texts.ただし、敵が変化しても強さがあまり代わり映えしないようなバランスだとこの効果は実: However, this effect will not be noticeable if the balance makes the enemies feel much the same in terms of strength, even when they change. Be sure to give the enemies distinct personalities.
texts.時折、敵が行動する前に一方的に完封できてしまうシステム＆バランスの作品も見かける: I sometimes see games with systems and balance that allow players to completely shut down enemies before they can even act. Be careful, because this has the same problem: the enemies' unique characteristics become impossible to see.

texts.ロマサガシリーズのように、雑魚戦は短期決戦かつ激しい戦闘を意識するといいかもしれ: As in the Romancing SaGa series, it may be a good idea to make trash mob battles short but intense.
texts.戦闘を何度も長々と見せられるのが退屈なのだったら、なるべく見せないでしまえという: If having to watch long battles over and over is boring, the idea is to show as little of them as possible.
texts.格下との戦闘を短期決戦にしたり、自動戦闘でサクッと終わらせられるようにする。マザ: Make battles against weaker enemies short and decisive, or allow them to end quickly through auto-battle. In some games, such as the EarthBound series, weaker enemies can be instantly defeated without entering battle.
texts.あるいは、ダンジョンの長さやエンカウント率を抑えて、ほどほどの戦闘回数で次へ進め: Alternatively, you could limit dungeon length and encounter rates so that players can move on after a moderate number of battles.
texts.また、逃走率を高めに設定するのも、戦闘の比重を下げる方策である。: Also, setting a high escape rate is another way to reduce the emphasis on combat.
texts.ドラクエの聖水のように格下の敵とのエンカウント率を下げるアイテムやスキルを作るの: It might also be a good idea to create items or skills that reduce the encounter rate with weaker enemies, like Dragon Quest's Holy Water.
texts.この種の機能はシンボルエンカウントだとあまり見かけないが、工夫次第でやりようはあ: You do not often see this kind of feature with symbol encounters, but it can be implemented with some ingenuity, so I encourage you to give it a try.
texts.あるいは、レベルが上がると自動的に敵が寄ってこなくなるようなシステムを作ってみて: Alternatively, you could try creating a system in which enemies automatically stop approaching you once your level gets high enough.
texts.ただし、道中の雑魚戦の回数を抑えても、ボス戦が壁となって結局雑魚戦での稼ぎを何度: However, even if you limit the number of regular battles along the way, it defeats the purpose if a boss battle becomes a roadblock and ultimately forces the player to grind through regular battles repeatedly.

texts.ここでいう報酬とは経験値やお金などを意味しており、その大半がプレイヤーの強化につ: The rewards mentioned here mean things such as experience points and money, most of which contribute to strengthening the player.
texts.報酬が多いということは、プレイヤー側の強化も早いということ。: More rewards also mean faster progression for the player.

texts.逆に言うと、戦闘の報酬が乏しい作品では戦闘の作業感が増してしまう。: Conversely, in games with meager combat rewards, battles feel even more like chores.
texts.これはシステム面の問題によって引き起こされることもある。: This can also be caused by problems with the game systems.

texts.では、ただ報酬を多くすればいいかというと、これも意外と難しい。: That said, simply increasing the rewards is surprisingly difficult as well.

texts.つまり、報酬が多いほど報酬が機能しなくなるのが早いという矛盾があるのだ。: In other words, the more generous the rewards are, the sooner they stop serving their purpose—a contradiction.
texts.対策としては、やはり報酬は程々に割り当てることだろう。: As a countermeasure, it is probably best to keep the rewards at a moderate level.
texts.あるいは、敵の強さを負けじとインフレさせる方法も考えられるが、こちらは弊害もそれ: Another possibility is to increase the enemies' strength just as aggressively, but this also has quite a few negative side effects. There is a limit, since the game could end up becoming a simplistic experience where leveling up is all that matters.
texts.他にも、戦闘内容によって報酬を増やすような仕組みがあれば、勝敗の確定した雑魚戦で: Alternatively, if there were a system that increased rewards based on how the battle was fought, it might give players a reason to put effort into their actions even in regular battles whose outcome is already certain.
texts.ただし、それ自体が新たな作業を生み出すこともあるので要注意。: However, be careful, as this itself could create a new chore.

texts.その原因と対策を考えたのが、この記事だと言える。: This article could be said to be my attempt to consider the causes and solutions.
texts.特に近年はリソース管理のゆるい作品が増加傾向にあり、加えてマップも広大化している: In particular, games with lenient resource management have been increasing in recent years, and maps have also been growing larger, resulting in more battles. I suspect these are major causes.
